mapper.insert: insert into inventory_transaction (inventory_id, sku_id, warehouse_code, tx_type, quantity, before_qty, after_qty, biz_type, biz_no, operator_id, create_time, remark) values (#{inventoryId}, #{skuId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{txType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{bizType}, #{bizNo}, #{operatorId}, sysdate(), #{remark})
